headlines.description: League Two Fleetwood shocked Premier League champions Arsenal in a penalty shootout to advance to the Carabao Cup quarterfinals after a 1-1 draw on Tuesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fourth-tier Fleetwood Town stun Arsenal in Carabao Cup shootout

events.name: Brighton & Hove Albion at Manchester City

headlines.description: Manchester City's backup goalkeeper Gerónimo Rulli saved two spot-kicks as the holders beat Brighton 4-3 on penalties to edge into the Carabao Cup quarterfinals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Man City survive penalties to advance past Brighton

headlines.description: Liverpool saw off Chelsea in another Carabao Cup penalty shootout as former Reds midfielder Xabi Alonso suffered his third defeat as a manager at Anfield.
headlines.shortLinkText: Liverpool beat Chelsea in shootout to reach Carabao Cup quarters

headlines.description: Everton set up a Carabao Cup quarterfinal against League Two Fleetwood as they eased to a 3-1 win over Newcastle United on Thursday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Everton beat Newcastle, will face Fleetwood in Carabao quarters
